text:
Auditor-Jane: Hi team, auditor here — for tomorrow's SOC2 fieldwork we need a compact access-provenance bundle for two items: (1) a recent RBAC role change affecting svc-redwood-batch on 2025-11-02, and (2) KMS decrypt events tied to that service account in the same window. Can you confirm what artifacts we can produce?

sam_sec: @Auditor-Jane yep, we can provide role-change diffs + signed snapshots of the commit that applied them. also can pull CloudTrail events for KMS Decrypt. quick Q: do you need raw CloudTrail JSON or an extracted CSV with hashes?

Auditor-Jane: CSV with SHA256 hashes for each event would be ideal — auditor wants immutable checksums. Raw JSON should be available as backup.

ida_devops: Thanks — we have three pieces to stitch: rolebinding change (k8s audit), terraform apply + git commit, and CloudTrail entries for KMS decrypt. plan: 
- k8s audit logs (from EKS AuditSink) 
- terraform state + git commit ID 
- CloudTrail S3 objects + CloudWatch logs link 

ida_devops: Example splunk/s3 query we'll run: 
```splunk
index=cloudtrail source="s3:aws-cloudtrail/*" eventName="Decrypt" userIdentity.principalId="AROA123EXAMPLE" | table _time, eventID, requestParameters, userIdentity, resources
```

sam_sec: For kubernetes role changes we'll export the kube-apiserver audit slice with these fields: verb, user.username, objectRef, requestURI, responseStatus, stageTimestamp. then sign the bundle and include a manifest file with SHA256 for each file.

matt_compliance: Auditor-Jane — we also need to show chain-of-custody for the signed bundle (who packaged it, who uploaded it, where). On our side we'll include: packaging user, packaging host, timestamp, and pre-signed S3 URL with 7-day expiry. ok?

Auditor-Jane: Yes that's perfect. Also auditor asked for any compensating controls: e.g., ephemeral key usage, KMS grants, or automated rotation. If any grants were used for the decrypts, please annotate.

ida_devops: Noted. Early look shows decrypts used a KMS grant for cross-account service role. We'll mark those events and include grantId fields. sample CloudTrail snippet we'll attach: 
```json
{
  "eventVersion": "1.08",
  "eventTime": "2025-11-02T15:24:12Z",
  "eventName": "Decrypt",
  "userIdentity": { "type": "AssumedRole", "arn": "arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/redwood-svc-role/svc-redwood-batch" },
  "requestParameters": { "encryptionContext": { "purpose": "batch-run" } },
  "resources": [{"ARN":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01"}]
}
```

sam_sec: On the RBAC side, k8s RBAC shows a RoleBinding edit by `gitops-bot` at 2025-11-02T15:20:05Z. But git commit was authored by `ida_devops` with CI pipeline user `ci-runner` — we'll capture all three identities in the manifest.

oncall-bot: Reminder: evidence-bundle task queued (task id eb-20251102-77). Upload will go to s3://redwood-compliance/audits/soc2/2025-11-02/ after packaging.

matt_compliance: One more ask from the auditor — can you annotate any vulnerability tickets that coincide with that time window? If a vuln was opened or a triage note references the role change, include links and a short summary.

ida_devops: I searched JIRA — two tickets: INF-4922 (privilege-review) created 2025-11-02 16:00, and VULN-231 (minor S3 policy lint) created 2025-11-03. INF-4922 references the role change. we'll include excerpts (redacted) and link to ticket IDs.

Auditor-Jane: Great. Final: can you confirm retention for evidence snapshots (where they will live and for how long)? auditor needs cover for 90 days post-fieldwork.

sam_sec: We'll store the signed bundle in the compliance S3 bucket with object lifecycle: 180 days full retention then archival to Glacier for 2 years. We'll include an ACL + bucket policy proof screenshot.

Auditor-Jane: Thanks all. If you can assemble the CSV of KMS decrypt events + manifest + signed SHA256 list and post a pre-signed URL by EOD today that should be enough for the initial review. :pray:

ida_devops: On it — aiming to upload by 17:30 PT. I'll ping here when done and include checksums.

sam_sec: I'll produce the manifest and GPG-sign it. Will post the key fingerprint in the bundle.

oncall-bot: evidence-bundle eb-20251102-77 succeeded (s3://redwood-compliance/audits/soc2/2025-11-02/bundle-eb-20251102-77.tar.gz). checksum: sha256:3f7a9d...

Auditor-Jane: Received, thanks — I'll confirm once the auditor team validates the hashes against the objects.

matt_compliance: Nice work everyone, this is a clean handoff.

ida_devops: Closing loop — posted CSV and manifest at pre-signed links in the task. tagging @matt_compliance for retention confirmation.

Auditor-Jane: Closing thread for now. If auditors need deeper forensic extracts we'll reopen. Appreciate the fast turnaround. :white_check_mark:
